description: This file contains function prototypes for the exported API of the Slap Loam Client object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component. It includes declarations for creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions related to the Loam Client, as well as a factory function for creating the client instance.

methods.name: SlapCreateLoamClient
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Loam Client object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: SlapLcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the SLAP Loam Client object with specified context handles.

methods.name: SlapLcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Loam Client object instance.

methods.name: SlapLcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the Loam Client.
